main.description: Verify signatures on a signed record (`network.attested.payment`, `network.attested.entitlement`, or any `com.atiproto.*` record using the same scheme). Open to any caller. Implemented by both brokers (over their `network.attested.payment` records) and the PoS (over its own records). To retrieve hydrated payment details, call `network.attested.payment.status`, which auto-fills private fields when the caller is a signing party.

uri.description: URI of the record to verify.

cid.description: CID of the record at verification time.

valid.description: True when every signature in `signatures` validates against the canonical signing payload.

signatures.description: Verified signatures from the record. Each entry is either an inline `network.attested.signature` or a `com.atproto.repo.strongRef` to a remote `network.attested.proof` record.

workflow.description: Optional. Present when cross-layer verification requires the agent to call the other party (e.g. PoS verifying a cart wants the broker's payment status).
